title: 第15章 悲观的苏家无声的对决第16章 莽山苏氏灭
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: 另一边。
莽山苏氏自然也收到了李家即将来犯的消息。
临时主持族务的二长老苏白召集了诸多苏家高层，商讨对策。
“太上闭了死关，还未出关，家主与四长老去了府城后到现在都还没有回来，我苏家拿什么抵御李家。”
苏家三长老一脸绝望的道。
一众苏家高层也是唉声叹气。
看到族内人心不振，二长老心中不禁生出一种无力感。
“无论如何，我苏家都不会引颈就戮，就是死，也要咬下李家一块肉来。”
苏白咬牙切齿的道。
“诸位，现在是我苏家立族两百年以来最为危险的时候，我们必须做好最坏的打算，七长老，你带着家族的火种，从小路下山，赶紧走，若苏家不能存续，你们便改名换姓，离开升龙府！”
众人当即表示同意。
唯独七长老，气冲冲的站起了身来：“怎么，难道你们觉得我就是那贪生怕死之人不成，要走你们走，我不走！”
“老七，都啥时候了，不要意气用事！”
苏白站起身来怒喝道。
“没人说你怕死，我也知道你不怕死，但我们这些人，都是一些老东西了，不死也没几年好活了，你不同，你还年轻，家族的火种还需要庇佑，你明白了吗？”
七长老当场便呆住了。
“还愣在这干嘛，赶紧走啊！”
苏白狠狠的一脚踹在了七长老的腿上，愤怒的吼道。
七长老被他这一脚踹了一个趔趄，差点没站稳。
他深深的看了一眼在场的众人，咬了咬牙，转身头也不回的走了。
看到这一幕，二长老心中总算是松了一口气。
然后道：“诸位，我苏家的后路算是安排好了，应该还有半个时辰的时间，大家还有什么未了的事，赶紧去安排吧。”
苏白言语中的悲观，渲染了众人。
“堂堂的莽山苏氏，何至于此啊。”
四长老泪流满面的道。
想到家族即将覆亡，几位长老都是小声抽泣了起来。
“都是一把老骨头了，何必做那妇人状？丢不丢人？”
二长老怒声训斥道。
“二哥，我们哭的不是自己，是家族啊。”
二长老张了张嘴，最终颓然的瘫坐在了椅子上。
“我们都是苏家的罪人啊。”
“还没到最后时刻呢，你们就做出这副死人样子，给谁看呢？”
content_en:
other side.
Naturally, the Su family in Mangshan also received news that the Li family was about to invade.
Su Bai, the second elder who was temporarily in charge of family affairs, summoned many senior officials of the Su family to discuss countermeasures.
"The Supreme Master has been locked up in death confinement and has not yet come out. The head of the family and the fourth elder have not come back since they went to Fucheng. What can our Su family do to resist the Li family?"
The third elder of the Su family said with a look of despair.
All the senior executives of the Su family also sighed.
Seeing the depressed people in the clan, the second elder couldn't help but feel a sense of powerlessness in his heart.
"No matter what, we, the Su family, will not kill anyone at their necks. Even if they die, we will bite off a piece of the Li family's flesh."
Su Bai gritted his teeth and said.
"Everyone, this is the most dangerous time in the two hundred years since our Su family was established. We must prepare for the worst. Seventh Elder, take the family's fire and go down the mountain from the path. Leave quickly. If the Su family cannot survive, you will change your name and leave Shenglong Mansion!"
Everyone immediately agreed.
Only the seventh elder stood up angrily: "Why, do you think I am just a person who is greedy for life and afraid of death? If you want to leave, you can leave, but I won't leave!"
"Old Qi, what time is it? Don't be impulsive!"
Su Bai stood up and shouted angrily.
"No one said that you are afraid of death, and I know that you are not afraid of death, but we are all old people, and we don't have many years to live without death. You are different. You are still young, and the family's fire still needs protection. Do you understand?"
The seventh elder was stunned on the spot.
"Why are you still standing here? Let's go quickly!"
Su Bai kicked the seventh elder hard on the leg and roared angrily.
The Seventh Elder was staggered by his kick and almost lost his balance.
He took a deep look at everyone present, gritted his teeth, turned around and left without looking back.
Seeing this scene, the second elder finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Then he said: "Everyone, our Su family's retreat has been arranged. There should be half an hour left. If you have any unfinished business, hurry up and make arrangements."
The pessimism in Su Bai's words exaggerated everyone.
"Why is the dignified Mangshan Su family like this?"
The fourth elder said with tears streaming down his face.
Thinking of the imminent demise of their family, several elders began to sob softly.
"They are all old bones, why do they need to look like that woman? Isn't it embarrassing?"
The second elder scolded angrily.
"Second brother, we are not crying for ourselves, but for our family."
The second elder opened his mouth, and finally slumped down on the chair.
"We are all sinners of the Su family."
........
"It's not even the last moment, you're acting like a dead person, who are you going to show it to?"
